title: Resolution Sensitivity of Attention-Entropy OOD Detection in Vision Transformers: A Controlled Bidirectional Analysis — Major Revision Release
description: Major-revision software and replication release for Pattern Recognition manuscript PR-D-26-04876. The revision evaluates attention entropy as a training-free internal OOD monitoring signal across four prespecified positional-encoding families (Learned, Sinusoidal, RoPE, ALiBi), six seeds, ViT-B and ViT-S. It adds the controlled CIFAR-100 native/coarse 2×2 experiment, MSP/Energy controls, ViT-S cross-scale replication, harmonized fixed-PE inference, layer score-orientation audits, checkpoint provenance, and reviewer-facing ledgers. The original E6 random-PE pre-specified replication gate remains failed; the harmonized fixed-PE result is a narrower post-audit estimand and is not presented as a retroactive gate pass.
